links.comparator_used: Default knowledge and flowchart embedding; the T026 arm was plain-text RAG from the ACR IFC algorithm PDF document.
links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM follow-up recommendations for pancreatic cystic lesion management
links.effect: Radiologist 1: default knowledge 42.4%, plain-text RAG 23.7%, flowchart embedding 89.9% (p < .001); radiologist 2: 39.9%, 24.2%, and 91.9% (p < .001); radiologist 3: 40.9%, 25.3%, and 91.9% (p < .001).
links.quote: The accuracy of the LLM follow-up recommendations based on default knowledge, plain-text RAG, and flowchart embedding for radiologist 1 was 42.4%, 23.7%, and 89.9% (p < .001), respectively; radiologist 2 was 39.9%, 24.2%, and 91.9% (p < .001); and radiologist 3 was 40.9%, 25.3%, and 91.9% (p < .001).

links.comparator_used: Plain-text RAG from the guideline PDF (default document format), where flowcharts and tables are not converted to text
links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM follow-up recommendations adherent to the ACR IFC guidance
links.effect: Flowchart embedding using the LLM's image-to-text conversion reached 89.9-91.9% accuracy versus 23.7-25.3% for plain-text RAG (p < .001).
links.quote: The accuracy of the LLM follow-up recommendations based on default knowledge, plain-text RAG, and flowchart embedding for radiologist 1 was 42.4%, 23.7%, and 89.9% (p < .001), respectively; radiologist 2 was 39.9%, 24.2%, and 91.9% (p < .001); and radiologist 3 was 40.9%, 25.3%, and 91.9% (p < .001).
